item.title: Best Self-Hosted ICAP Servers 2026: c-icap vs icapeg vs Python ICAP-YARA
item.description: The Internet Content Adaptation Protocol (ICAP) is an often-overlooked but powerful standard that enables content filtering, virus scanning, and traffic modification between HTTP proxies and specialized filtering servers. This guide compares three open-source ICAP server implementations — c-icap, icapeg, and python-icap-yara — for self-hosted content filtering deployments.

item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Egress Gateways: Cilium Egress vs Istio Egress vs Squid Proxy
item.description: Controlling outbound traffic from Kubernetes clusters is a critical requirement for organizations with strict security, compliance, or data governance policies. Without proper egress controls, any pod in your cluster can reach any external endpoint — a scenario that opens the door to data exfiltration, unauthorized API calls, and compliance violations.
